tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Tangential limit commutes with the Jacobi limit] If $\tau _1=0$, then \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial u}\left(\lim _{\tau \rightarrow 0}\sqrt{\tau }X(\tau ,u)\right)|_{u=0}= \lim _{\tau \rightarrow 0}\sqrt{\tau }\frac{d}{d\tau }Y(\tau ). \] \end{claim}

Proof

\sketch This follows by the substitution $s=\sqrt{\tau }$. replacing $\tau $ by $s=\sqrt{\tau }$.
